boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named campus places for studying, recreation, student activities, and low-key exploration.

cards.title: Thompson Library
cards.subtitle: Neil Avenue Mall
cards.notes: Use the study areas, then stop at the information desk or BuckeyeBar if your group needs research or technology help.
cards.short_summary: A central library with study seating, computers, group rooms, and student support services.
cards.evidence_claim: Thompson Library provides study spaces, more than 230 computers, group-study-room reservations, a Writing Center, and BuckeyeBar technology consultation.
cards.source_title: Thompson Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Library hours and services vary; consult the location page before visiting.

cards.title: 18th Avenue Library
cards.subtitle: 175 West 18th Avenue
cards.notes: Bring your BuckID for overnight access, and use the study pods, computers, or reservable group rooms as your work calls for.
cards.short_summary: A science-and-engineering library with extended access, computers, and group study rooms.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers public computers and group-study-room reservations; it is open 24 hours Monday through Friday with current OSU ID required overnight.
cards.source_title: 18th Avenue Library | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Current OSU ID is required from midnight to 7 a.m.; hours may change during breaks and holidays.

cards.title: Research Commons
cards.subtitle: Third floor of 18th Avenue Library
cards.notes: For a research-heavy group project, check its focus areas and connect with staff about data, visualization, GIS, or digital humanities.
cards.short_summary: A research-support space for graduate students, faculty, and postdoctoral researchers.
cards.evidence_claim: Research Commons connects graduate students, faculty, and postdoctoral researchers with experts across research-data, visualization, GIS, and digital-humanities work.
cards.source_title: Research Commons | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Located on the third floor of 18th Avenue Library; listed hours are weekdays, 9 a.m.–5 p.m.

cards.title: Ohio Union
cards.subtitle: 1739 N. High Street
cards.notes: Use the building as a meeting point, then look for events, student-organization resources, or the third-floor reflection and meditation rooms.
cards.short_summary: The Student Life hub for campus events, services, and student organization activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ohio Union provides building services and includes an Interfaith Prayer and Reflection Room with meditation rooms; Student Activities supports student organizations.
cards.access_notes: Building hours change during holidays, academic breaks, and summer; check current Ohio Union hours.

cards.title: RPAC
cards.subtitle: 337 Annie & John Glenn Avenue
cards.notes: Plan an active break around the facility’s open recreation schedule, and confirm eligibility or guest access before you go.
cards.short_summary: A large campus recreation complex with fitness, aquatic, gym, and event spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: The RPAC is a multipurpose campus recreation complex with fitness spaces, event areas, an aquatic facility, gyms, and meeting spaces.
cards.source_title: Recreation and Physical Activity Center (RPAC) | Recreational Sports
cards.access_notes: Review the open recreation schedule and facility access rules before arrival.

cards.title: The Oval
cards.subtitle: Central academic campus
cards.notes: Meet on the lawn for a between-class reset, then follow campus programming or student-organization activity happening nearby.
cards.short_summary: The historic central green where campus activities have taken place for generations.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State Libraries describes the approximately 11-acre Oval as the scene of a wide variety of student, faculty, and alumni activities since 1910.
cards.source_title: Historic Ohio State: FAQ | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Outdoor conditions and scheduled campus events affect use.

cards.title: Mirror Lake
cards.subtitle: Mirror Lake District
cards.notes: Walk the restored district and take in the lake from its paths and overlooks; stay out of the water basin.
cards.short_summary: A restored historic landscape in an iconic early section of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State’s Mirror Lake District restoration retained the area’s historic character while improving safety, sustainability, biodiversity, and learning environments.
cards.source_title: Mirror Lake District | Facilities Operations and Development
cards.access_notes: Do not enter the lake or water basin; Ohio State prohibits recreational use of Mirror Lake.

cards.title: Browning Amphitheatre
cards.subtitle: Mirror Lake District
cards.notes: Check whether an event is scheduled, or use the tiered outdoor setting as a calm place to meet, read, or take a break.
cards.short_summary: A historic outdoor amphitheater beside Mirror Lake.
cards.evidence_claim: Ohio State documents Browning Amphitheatre as part of the restored Mirror Lake District and notes its renovation history as an outdoor performance setting.
cards.source_title: Mirror Lake | Ohio State University Libraries
cards.access_notes: Use is subject to weather and scheduled events.

cards.title: Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum
cards.subtitle: Sullivant Hall, 1813 N. High Street
cards.notes: Visit the galleries together, then request collection material ahead if you want to use the reading room for a deeper look.
cards.short_summary: A public-facing cartoon and comics museum with galleries and a special-collections reading room.
cards.evidence_claim: Billy Ireland’s galleries and reading room are open to the public with free admission; collection materials must be requested in advance for reading-room use.
cards.source_title: Visit | Billy Ireland Cartoon Library & Museum
cards.access_notes: Gallery and reading-room hours differ; non-flash photography is permitted in galleries, and bags may need to be stored.

cards.title: Orton Geological Museum
cards.subtitle: Orton Hall, south side of The Oval
cards.notes: Check ahead that the gallery is staffed, then pair a museum visit with a look at Orton Hall’s chimes and stone exterior.
cards.short_summary: A free geological museum inside the landmark Orton Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission to the Orton Geological Museum is free and open to all; Orton Hall houses the museum and the University Chimes.
cards.access_notes: The gallery’s hours can vary, especially in summer; call or email ahead to confirm it is open.
